Please see [[:ja:WP:CFW#川村一彦の著作物]] ( https://w.wiki/AWqv ). |date=November 2024}} The region that was controlled by Yorimitsu was {{ill|Lake Suwa|ar|بحيرة سوا|arz|بحيره سوا|ceb|Suwa Ko|de|Suwa-See|eo|Suŭa-Lago|es|Lago Suwa|et|Suwa järv|eu|Suwa aintzira|fa|دریاچه سووا|fr|Lac Suwa|id|Danau Suwa|ja|諏訪湖|ko|스와호|lt|Suva (ežeras)|mk|Сува (езеро)|my|ဆုဝကန်|nn|Suwasjøen|pl|Suwa (jezioro)|ro|Lacul Suwa|ru|Сува (озеро)|sr|Језеро Сува|th|ทะเลสาบซูวะ|tr|Suwa Gölü|vi|Hồ Suwa|zh|諏訪湖|zh_yue|諏訪湖|qid=Q1206692|lt=Lake Suwa}}.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=正治 |first=笹本 |date=1992-12-25 |title=Vanished Customs |url=https://cir.nii.ac.jp/crid/1390853649019501568 |journal=国立歴史民俗博物館研究報告 = Bulletin of the National Museum of Japanese History |language=ja |volume=45 |pages=195–212 |doi=10.15024/00000585}}</ref> During the year of 1485, Yorimitsu's father was killed by his own retainers for unknown reasons.
